question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Lady Stranleigh continued to smile at him __brilliantly__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dimly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"brilliantly"** means very bright or radiant; exceptionally clever or talented. (प्रज्वलित)
 
 
• **Example: **The fireworks lit up the night sky brilliantly.
 
 
 
• **"Dimly"** refers to something that is not bright or clear, having or giving little light. (मंद)
 
 
• **Example: **The room was dimly lit by a single lamp.
